records.key: What happens when a run fails or spaCR crashes, including a setting or validation error found before a run starts. "Summarize" has the AI chosen above explain the error in the console. "Send" files an anonymised report as a public GitHub issue on EinarOlafsson/spacr through spaCR's relay, with no GitHub account. Default: summarize and send all errors.

"Summarize" lässt die oben gewählte KI den Fehler in der Konsole erklären.
